summary: Duplicate-order concurrency coverage is effectively absent; the primary gap belongs in integration coverage, with focused unit cases and one E2E smoke.
findings: The non-atomic race is findByRequestId followed by insert in the submit path.
Relevant surfaces are test/unit/submit.test.mjs, test/integration/order-api.test.mjs, e2e/checkout.spec.mjs, src/orders/store.mjs, src/api/orders.mjs, and test/fixtures/orders.mjs.
actions: Integration: synchronize same requestId submissions with a barrier and prove one insert and one row.
Integration: concurrent different request IDs both succeed.
Unit/integration: failed insertion retry succeeds, conflicting payload returns the defined API response/status, and retry semantics remain deterministic.
E2E: retain one normal duplicate-submit smoke; do not use E2E as the concurrency proof.
